about_the_game:
WHAT IS LUDUS?

Do you want to manage a ludus in the ancient Roman Empire? I can almost hear you asking, “What’s a ludus anyway?” A ludus is what they called the schools that trained gladiators for the people’s favorite event—gladiator fights. And you’re very close to running one of them.

GAME FEATURES:

Train your gladiator, set up your camp, and dominate fights across different cities in the Roman Empire. Shape your story based on the character you choose. Make different choices in dialogues to determine your path.

Sometimes, gather intel from rival luduses and choose your gladiator accordingly. Craft new items for your fighters, or brew potions to boost their strength. Manage your ludus however you like.

No matter how well you manage it, sometimes things happen out of the blue. Fate... So watch out for random events that may occur.

If you want to casually manage a ludus in the ancient Roman Empire, this game is just for you.
